A second run of the same process, used to check that the first run is stable.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Folder and imports
sections.what: Brings in the file, path and assertion tools and sets the folder for the evidence repair files.
sections.why: Likely reason: one folder setting keeps every path consistent.
sections.watch_out: File names must match exactly, or the load fails.

sections.name: load
sections.title: Loading and checking the rerun
sections.what: Loads both the committed run and the rerun, then checks the rerun made no updates and held no new fields.
sections.why: Likely reason: a stable rerun shows that the first run's decisions are reliable.
sections.watch_out: If the rerun is not clean, the script stops, so the rerun must be fixed first.

sections.name: esc
sections.title: Building and writing the audit page
sections.what: Escapes text and builds one section per project with a table of withheld fields, the previous value with its currency and unit, the reason, and the sources. It then writes the audit page and prints a line.
sections.why: Likely reason: the per-project sections let a reviewer check each held value against its reason.
sections.watch_out: Previous values are shown as they were before being withheld, so they are not confirmed figures.

summary: Builds an HTML audit page of withheld values, showing each old value with its decision and sources, after confirming a rerun changed nothing.
purpose: It records which values were held back during evidence resolution, what they were before, and why.
why: Likely reason: an audit record of the resolution decisions for later review.
how: It reads the committed and rerun results, asserts the rerun made no updates and held no fields, then builds one section per project with a table of withheld fields and their sources, and writes the page.
risks: The page shows old unverified values, so they must not be read as confirmed facts. The template is cut off in this excerpt.
debug: An assertion error on load means the rerun was not clean, so check the rerun file. A missing source in the page means its entry is missing from the report rows.
